comment.narrative: Although efforts to draft a new PPL began in 2020 no progress has been made toward its adoption. A working group supported by the project produced the first draft in 2022. This was subsequently replaced by new drafts prepared by the Ministry of Finance Labour and Transfers MFLT in 2023 and 2024. On each occasion the Project conducted a thorough analysis of the drafts providing detailed comments and identifying areas requiring further attention.The Project has consistently offered its support to the MFLT in finalizing the draft PPL. However the MFLT has neither genuinely relied on the Projects assistance nor adequately considered the comments and proposals for improving the draft provided by the Project. As a result the current status of the draft remains unclear and no public consultations have been initiated.

comment.narrative: Although efforts to draft a new PPL began in 2020 no progress has been made toward its adoption. A working group supported by the project produced the first draft in 2022. This was subsequently replaced by new drafts prepared by the Ministry of Finance Labour and Transfers MFLT in 2023 and 2024. On each occasion the Project conducted a thorough analysis of the drafts providing detailed comments and identifying areas requiring further attention.The Project has consistently offered its support to the MFLT in finalizing the draft PPL. However the MFLT has neither genuinely relied on the Projects assistance nor adequately considered the comments and proposals for improving the draft provided by the Project. As a result the current status of the draft remains unclear and no public consultations have been initiated.
